answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 56 epochs. Receipts are issued in pigment, burned on slash in relic, and listed in jetty. That removes the yield a hostile operator would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Every extra alias adds 8 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
